California Accountability Panel#

A dashboard that displays key school performance metrics.

Dashboard panel

View key school performance metrics and California state-wide metrics.

  • View our website.

Who it’s for

For people who want real‑time, personalized performance data.

  • Guardians

  • Schools

  • Educational Policy Makers

Metrics

Metrics are based on student assessment results and other aspects of school performance.

Public data

Uses public data from the California Department of Education.

CSV upload

Use your own data by uploading a CSV file.

Contribute

We welcome contributions! The project is open-source.

  • GitHub docs
